description:
ClosureHandler<B> in jmap-server receives CallerCtx in JmapHandler::call but does not forward it to the handler closure. BackendCallFn<B> is typed as Fn(Arc<B>, String, Value) -> HandlerFuture with no CallerCtx parameter. All seven register_*_handlers functions build closures with this shape and silently discard the caller context.

Fix: Add a CallerCtx-aware variant — either generalize ClosureHandler to ClosureHandler<B, C> with BackendCallFnWithCtx<B, C>, or add a parallel type. Then update all seven register_*_handlers functions to forward CallerCtx to each handler closure.

This is a breaking API change (changes the closure shape of all register_*_handlers). Ship all 8 crates simultaneously.

Affected crates: jmap-server, jmap-mail-server, jmap-chat-server, jmap-contacts-server, jmap-calendars-server, jmap-sharing-server, jmap-tasks-server, jmap-filenode-server.
title: CallerCtx forwarding through register_*_handlers
